name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge
steps: Position the Smith machine bar across your upper back, stand slightly ahead of the bar line, and unrack it smoothly.
Step one foot straight back onto the ball of your foot while keeping your front foot planted firmly.
Lower your hips smoothly under control until your back knee nears the floor and your front thigh is parallel.
Drive through your front foot to stand tall again, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep most of your weight over your front heel and midfoot rather than pushing off the back leg.
Align your front knee cleanly over your toes throughout both the descent and ascent.
